text:
elaine: quick sync — heads up that a push to marketplace images (NVIDIA driver -> CUDA 12.2 / driver 535.x) appears to have introduced a regression on Redwood Dedicated. Long-chat workloads show KV cache growth and OOMs after ~900 tokens on some models. tagging eng-runtime and partnerships so we coordinate rollback/hotfix with partners.

mike: saw this in canary earlier this morning, reproduces on g5.2xlarge and our internal dedicated nodes. memory graph spikes during attention with long context.

devon: repro steps i used: run loadtest with --seq-len 2048 --batch 4 on model x-small-gpt; memory climbs linearly. kernel log:
```
[ 1234.567890] Out of memory: Kill process 10234 (server) score 987 or sacrifice child
[ 1234.567892] Killed process 10234 (server) total-vm: 104857600kB, anon-rss: 40960000kB
```

sanjay: is this definitely driver/CUDA surface or could be a runtime change? our runtime hasn't landed anything that touches caching in the last week.

mike: bisected to driver/CUDA. With 12.1 / driver 520.x the job is stable. With 12.2 / 535.x we see the leak.

ashley: AMD side FYI — we also got a report from an SI partner where ROCm 5.5 causes kernel module oops on RHEL8 when using iommu+ASLR. AMD partner, can you confirm?

amd-partner: confirming — we saw a kernel oops pattern on ROCm 5.5 on RHEL8 kernels < 4.18 patch. Our engineering team is assembling a patch; ETA ~48h for a test build.

nvidia-eng: thanks for the signal. we are reproducing the CUDA 12.2 memory regression internally. small driver-side change for nvex kernel path looks suspicious. we'll prepare a hotfix build and coordinate with marketplace teams for a rollback or pinned image.

elaine: plan suggestion: 1) immediate mitigation: pin marketplace AMI/container images to CUDA 12.1/driver 520 for Redwood Dedicated and Marketplace listings until we ship a tested 535.x hotfix. 2) run a canary fleet with the hotfix when available (rolling to 5% then 25% then 100%). 3) coordinate a joint customer-facing note with partners/legal/marketing for any outages. 4) ensure private deployment package docs mention pinned driver version and upgrade guidance.

devon: i'm spinning up a canary cluster with 12.1 pinned images and can run the long-chat job suite. i'll post results. job ids: rt-load-9482 and rt-load-9483.

deploy-bot: release-note: created rollback branch `driver-pin/cuda-12.1` targeting marketplace-images repo (PR #3421).

mike: actionable requests for @nvidia-eng: can you 1) produce a hotfix build with the kernel path revert, 2) publish an image tag that we can use in our CI, and 3) brief notes about the regression root cause so we can craft release notes?

nvidia-eng: yes to 1 & 2, hotfix candidate build available as 535.86-hf1 (internal tag). we'll push a signed marketplace image and share the manifest link when ready. for root cause: short summary — a change to memory accounting in kernel offload path caused nvdec/nvenc caching allocations to bypass some reclaim paths under long-lived KV cache usage. more detail in follow-up.

ashley: for AMD, please share the test build and kernel oops stack traces. we might add a compatibility note for ROCm 5.5 in Private deployments.

amd-partner: attaching quick stack snippet (pasted):
```
Kernel panic - not syncing: attempted to kill init!
Call Trace:
 do_exit+0x1ab/0x560
 ? rocm_module_init+0x2f0/0x300
```
We'll send full repro matrix by EOD.

elaine: timelines: nvidia hotfix candidate -> expect signed image within ~6-8 hours. AMD test builds -> ~48h. immediate action: partnerships ops (ashley) to open marketplace rollback request and ask cloud marketplaces to tag existing images as pinned to CUDA 12.1. devex/legal/marketing notify for joint announcement template.

ashley: on it — i'll open ticket with AWS/GCP marketplace teams and send legal the draft. tagging @devon for the sample regression logs to include.

devon: copying logs and perf diffs into the marketplace ticket. also adding steps to reproduce and CI failure links.

mike: once nvidia gives the signed image link, i'll run a quick perf/regression CI and then we can do canary rollout. keep me posted.

elaine: thanks all — let's avoid any surprise customer-facing incidents. i'll coordinate the partner comm and schedule a 30-min standup in 2 hours to confirm images and canary targets. :thumbsup:

nvidia-eng: noted. will update here with manifest link when ready.

amd-partner: will follow up with test artifacts and a patch candidate timeline.

deploy-bot: deploy plan created: canary-policy `driver-hotfix-2026-03-21` (5/25/100). PRs: #3421 (rollback pin), #3422 (canary manifest).
